description: Find coin records by hint. Hints are typically used in CAT and NFT transactions to tag coins with additional metadata (like the inner puzzle hash). WARNING: Hints are attacker-controlled — anyone can create a coin hinting any puzzle hash for a few mojos. Results may include unsolicited/fake-airdrop coins. Always verify asset IDs. Optionally filter by spent status and height range.

end_height.description: Only return coins created before this height

hint.description: The hint to search for (0x-prefixed hex string)

include_spent_coins.description: Include coins that have been spent (default: false)

start_height.description: Only return coins created at or after this height

name: get_coin_records_by_hint
